definitions.explanation: Refers collectively to multiple newspapers, treating each as a separate source. Standard journalism vocabulary for 'the press' considered paper-by-paper.

examples.japanese: {各紙|かくし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Each of the newspapers reported it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{各紙|かくし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: The incident made the front page of every paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社説|しゃせつ}→社説：04197_shasetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比|くら}べる→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{各紙|かくし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧わかる。
examples.english: Comparing the editorials, you can clearly see the difference in each paper's stance.

notes:
A formal compound: ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧ (each) + {紙|し} (here meaning newspaper, an abbreviation of ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧). Appears mostly in news, commentary, and writing about media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {各紙|かくし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{報|ほう}じる→報じる：17193_houjiru⟧: each paper reports
- {各紙|かくし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社説|しゃせつ}→社説：04197_shasetsu⟧: editorials of the various papers
- ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧{各紙|かくし}: all the national papers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{各社|かくしゃ}→各社：11057_kakusha⟧: each company — broader; covers any kind of company (TV networks, publishers, etc.)
- {新聞各社|しんぶんかくしゃ}: each newspaper company — refers to the publishers; {各紙|かくし} refers to the papers themselves
- ⟦マスコミ→マスコミ：03872_masukomi⟧: mass media — much broader and informal
